headline: Petrol prices soar and speculation: fruit and vegetables get more expensive
summary: Petrol price increases and speculation are pushing up fruit and vegetable prices in Italy. Kiwis cost above 6 euros per kilo in Genoa and green beans reached 7.50 euros in Bari.
why: Fuel costs feed into transport and distribution expenses for food, which can pass through to consumer inflation. Italy's food prices are closely watched by the European Central Bank.
